requirements.title: Alderwick area
requirements.officialRule: The home must be in an AW1, AW2, AW3 or AW4 postcode.
requirements.plainLanguage: This fictional scheme only covers homes in Alderwick.
requirements.evidence: The postcode answer is enough in this prototype.

requirements.title: Owner-occupied main home
requirements.officialRule: The applicant must own and live in the property. Joint owners and leaseholders may need additional permission.
requirements.plainLanguage: This grant is for owner-occupiers. The ownership questions change according to how the property is held.
requirements.evidence: A mortgage statement, title record or lease would be accepted in a real service.

requirements.title: Household finances
requirements.officialRule: The household must receive a listed income-related benefit or have annual income below £25,000, and hold less than £16,000 in savings.
requirements.plainLanguage: Complete either the benefit route or the income route. You do not need to answer both.
requirements.evidence: A current benefit notice or recent household income summary would be accepted.

requirements.title: Urgent effect
requirements.officialRule: The repair must remove an essential service, create an immediate safety risk or make an important room unusable.
requirements.plainLanguage: The site asks different safety questions for heating, electrical, structural, water and other repairs.
requirements.evidence: The repair description and the answers for the selected repair type are used in this prototype.

requirements.title: Repair cost
requirements.officialRule: The expected repair cost must be between £250 and £7,500 including tax.
requirements.plainLanguage: Costs outside this range are not covered by the fictional scheme.
requirements.evidence: A written contractor estimate can show the expected total.

requirements.title: Supporting evidence
requirements.officialRule: The applicant must have a written contractor estimate or clear photographs, plus evidence of ownership.
requirements.plainLanguage: The evidence questions change according to what you already have.
requirements.evidence: A written estimate or safely taken photographs, and a mortgage statement, title record or lease.

requirements.title: Applicant declaration
requirements.officialRule: The applicant must personally confirm that the answers are accurate before submission.
requirements.plainLanguage: Your agent cannot make this declaration or submit for you.
requirements.evidence: The visible human confirmation in this prototype.

validations.message: This fictional grant is only for people who own and live in the property.
Obtain agreement from every registered owner before review.
Check the lease and obtain any required freeholder permission before review.
Find evidence that you own the property before review.
Use the financial guidance to choose the benefit or income route before review.
This fictional grant requires a qualifying benefit or household income below £25,000.
Check the household savings amount before review.
This fictional grant is only for households with less than £16,000 in savings.
Gather evidence of household income before review.
The heating route requires a loss of heating or hot water.
The electrical route requires an immediate warning sign or an unresolved safety concern.
The structural route requires part of the home to be unsafe or potentially unsafe.
The repair must remove an essential service, create a safety risk or make an important room unusable.
